name: 36303 · Dothan, AL
findings: ZIP 36303 (Dothan) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36303 (Dothan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
